assay: bulk poly-A RNA-seq, gastrocnemius, NovaSeq 6000 2x150, Novogene (S2.10.p1)
organism: Mus musculus, male, inducible muscle-specific Bmal1 KO (HSA-Cre; Bmal1 fl/fl) vs vehicle (S2.2.p1)
sample_inclusion: 20 samples sequenced, n=5 per group, ~30 weeks of age (S2.10.p1); of 40 mice in the acute experiment only the younger cohort was sequenced
primary_estimand: acute exercise effect on gastrocnemius gene expression, within each genotype (Vehicle Ex vs Vehicle Ctrl; iMSBmal1KO Ex vs iMSBmal1KO Ctrl)
not_planned: no genotype-by-exercise interaction test is reported; genotype comparison is done by Venn overlap of the two DEG lists (117 shared, FIG1D)
repeated_measure_unit: none (one gastrocnemius per mouse, independent groups)
normalization: DESeq2 median of ratios within tissue (S2.11.p1)
method: Partek Flow DESeq2, negative binomial GLM, Wald test (S2.11.p1); STAR to mm10, Ensembl 99 quantification

paper_threshold.adjustment: FDR (DESeq2 Wald, Partek Flow; BH assumed)

unknown: whether Partek fitted all 4 groups jointly or each genotype separately (not_reported)
